1.explanation:
• packages/react/src/components/Tabs/Tabs.js – contains the React implementation of Tabs, including the logic that swaps between the <select> dropdown and the horizontal tablist based on container/viewport size. 
• packages/react/src/components/Tabs/Tabs-test.js – includes unit tests that assert the dropdown variant is rendered under certain width conditions. These tests must be updated or removed once the dropdown behavior is eliminated. 
• packages/react/src/components/Tabs/Tabs-story.js – the Storybook examples showcase both the dropdown and tablist variants; these stories should be updated to reflect only the tablist behavior. 
• packages/components/src/components/tabs/tabs.js – implements the vanilla JS Carbon component (Web Components) for Tabs, which also contains the responsive logic for rendering a dropdown. This file must be edited to remove the dropdown variant at the framework-agnostic level.
1.bug_scenario: The Tabs component currently switches to an HTML <select> dropdown when the available width falls below a certain threshold. In the first screenshot you can see the Tabs rendered as a dropdown list of options (“Tab label 1”, “Tab label 2”, “Tab label 3”, “Custom Label”). In the second screenshot, on a wider viewport, the Tabs render as a horizontal tablist with the second tab highlighted. The proposal is to remove that dropdown variant entirely so Tabs always render as a tablist regardless of container or viewport size.

2.explanation: packages/components/src/components/tabs/tabs.js implements the core logic that measures width and swaps the tab markup for a dropdown; packages/components/src/components/tabs/tabs.config.js defines the CSS selectors and class names for both tab and dropdown variants. On the React side, packages/react/src/components/Tabs/Tabs.js contains the JSX that renders either the Tab children or a <select> based on the same responsive check, with its associated story (Tabs-story.js) and unit test (Tabs.test.js) driving and validating that dropdown behavior. Removing or disabling the dropdown logic in these files will eliminate the unwanted variant.
2.bug_scenario: The Tabs component currently detects when the browser width falls below a fixed threshold and replaces the horizontal tab list with a native <select> dropdown. This behavior is problematic for accessibility (screen readers see a listbox instead of a tablist) and is tied to the global window width rather than the actual container width. The proposal is to remove this dropdown variant entirely so that Tabs always render as a horizontal tablist.
